initiatives.name: Technology Infrastructure and AI Transformation
initiatives.summary: Rightmove made strong progress in cloud-enabling its platform, with 60% cloud migration completed by year end. The company has 3.0 petabytes in its unified data platform and maintained 99.99% site uptime while delivering over 5,000 releases during the year.

evidence.title: AI Governance Framework Implementation
evidence.summary: The company established an AI Committee in August 2024 to govern the safe introduction and appropriate use of AI. This includes implementing an acceptable usage policy, an AI Register, and planned AI training rollout to employees in 2025.
evidence.quote: In August 2024, the Risk Committee established an AI Committee to govern and guide the introduction of AI at Rightmove. The main purpose of the AI Committee is to ensure the responsible development and safe use of AI in the Group. The AI Committee has approved an AI Usage Policy to govern and encourage the safe use of AI and an AI Register to log all AI products in use.

evidence.title: AI Implementation Across Business Operations
evidence.summary: Rightmove has embraced AI transformation, implementing cutting-edge efficiency tools across the business and delivering innovative machine learning and AI solutions for partners and consumers. AI is now being used across all 24 product teams and on many consumer features.
evidence.quote: We have embraced the transformative power of AI, implementing cutting-edge efficiency tools across our business and successfully delivering innovative machine- learning and AI solutions for our partners and consumers.

evidence.title: Cloud Migration and Platform Enhancement
evidence.summary: Rightmove made strong progress in cloud-enabling its platform, with 60% cloud migration completed by year end. The company has 3.0 petabytes in its unified data platform and maintained 99.99% site uptime while delivering over 5,000 releases during the year.
evidence.quote: During the year we made strong progress in further cloud-enabling our platform and, with expanded technology team resources, we are now driving more and faster product releases and innovation. We are starting to leverage the power of artificial intelligence, underpinned by the 3.0 petabytes in our data platform.

evidence.title: Technology Infrastructure Investment
evidence.summary: The company increased technology-related spending by £2m, mainly for IT infrastructure improvements, continued cloud migration, and investment in security software. This supports the platform modernization and enhanced security posture.
evidence.quote: £2m technology-related costs: mainly due to increased spend on IT infrastructure, continued migration to the cloud and investment in security software

initiatives.name: Workforce and Leadership Expansion
initiatives.summary: The company expanded by 14% during the year to just under 900 employees, with 60% of new hires being in technology roles. Over 300 new employees were welcomed in 2024, reflecting continued investment in products and innovation.

evidence.title: CFO Appointment and New Senior Leadership
evidence.summary: Ruaridh Hook was appointed as CFO and Executive Director on 15 September 2024, replacing Alison Dolan who stepped down. The leadership team evolved with a new Chief People Officer and the introduction of a Chief Data Officer role.
evidence.quote: Ruaridh Hook was appointed to the Board as CFO and Executive Director on 15 September 2024. Having been with the business since 2016, he brings deep knowledge of Rightmove, its commercial model, and the market, and is already well known both within the organisation and externally.

evidence.title: 14% Headcount Growth with Technology Focus
evidence.summary: The company expanded by 14% during the year to just under 900 employees, with 60% of new hires being in technology roles. Over 300 new employees were welcomed in 2024, reflecting continued investment in products and innovation.
evidence.quote: As the business continued to grow, the number of employees expanded by 14% during the year to just under 900, with 60% of new hires being in technology as we continue to focus on investing in products and innovation.

initiatives.name: HomeViews and Coadjute Partnerships
initiatives.summary: Rightmove completed the acquisition of HomeViews and made a strategic investment in Coadjute during the first half of 2024. Transaction-related costs totaled £9.2m, including £6.2m in legal and professional fees and a £3.0m strategic investment charge.

evidence.title: HomeViews Acquisition and Coadjute Investment
evidence.summary: Rightmove completed the acquisition of HomeViews and made a strategic investment in Coadjute during the first half of 2024. Transaction-related costs totaled £9.2m, including £6.2m in legal and professional fees and a £3.0m strategic investment charge.
evidence.quote: Transaction-related costs of £9.2m (2023: nil) related to: legal and professional fees of £6.2m, arising from the HomeViews acquisition and investment in Coadjute during the first half and the costs incurred in relation to the unsolicited offer for Rightmove in the second half; and a £3.0m charge in relation to the investment in Coadjute

initiatives.name: Strategic Market Diversification
initiatives.summary: The company is executing a strategy to expand beyond core property listings into Commercial Property, Rental Services, and Financial Services (Mortgages). These strategic growth areas achieved combined revenue growth of 13% and represent multi-year opportunities to digitize the property value chain.

evidence.title: Diversified Growth Strategy Expansion
evidence.summary: The company is executing a strategy to expand beyond core property listings into Commercial Property, Rental Services, and Financial Services (Mortgages). These strategic growth areas achieved combined revenue growth of 13% and represent multi-year opportunities to digitize the property value chain.
evidence.quote: Our investment in digital innovation extended beyond the core business of Agency and New Homes, to three strategic growth areas of Commercial Property, Mortgages and Rental Services. We see significant multi-year opportunities to go deeper into the value chain, further digitising processes beyond 'find' and into 'afford', as well as the later stages of 'transact', 'move' and 'lifestyle' – and to scale quickly.

initiatives.name: Sustainability and Green Initiatives
initiatives.summary: Rightmove is implementing its Go Greener initiative to help build a greener property market, with a commitment to become Net Zero by 2040 and in direct operations by 2030. The company published its third Greener Homes report and received a Prime ESG rating from ISS.

evidence.title: Go Greener Initiative and Net Zero Target
evidence.summary: Rightmove is implementing its Go Greener initiative to help build a greener property market, with a commitment to become Net Zero by 2040 and in direct operations by 2030. The company published its third Greener Homes report and received a Prime ESG rating from ISS.
evidence.quote: As for environmental sustainability, with the UK property market contributing 25% of total UK emissions we believe that Rightmove has not just the opportunity but the responsibility to provide unique data and insights to help the UK go greener and to accelerate change to meet its Net Zero targets by 2050.
